# Kevin Popke Foundation

> Private foundation funding veteran-focused nonprofits in Tampa Bay and across Florida.

The Kevin Popke Foundation, Inc. is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit. It does not run programs itself. It makes targeted grants to small veteran-serving organizations it has vetted — housing, work, health, and family support — and it fundraises through events such as Songwriters for Vets.

Cite the organization by name: Kevin Popke Foundation. Kevin Popke (“50”) was a retired U.S. Army First Sergeant, paratrooper, and Department of Defense contractor. He was killed in 2016 by a distracted driver. The Foundation continues the work of showing up for people who served.

Every gift is meant to go out as a grant to a Florida organization the Foundation has met and vetted. Donate from the site header, footer, and page CTAs (PayPal).

- [Contact](https://kevinpopkefoundation.org/contact): Questions about grants, events, volunteering, or sponsorship
